items.requirement: Maximise explicit goals in priority order
items.evidence: Planner.Pool.compareGoals/decidingGoal (Planner.java:414-427) compare plans goal by goal in priority order (MUST then WANT, Heuristics.goalOrder:459): reaching a goal beats missing it, between two misses the higher rank wins; the score decides only among goal ties (best/choose, 429-456). prioritise() (372-405) re-plans with goals 1..k when the best plan misses goal k while a later one exists. tradedFor() (472-486) names only a higher goal the kept plan reaches, else -1; Labels.notes and LinkStatus use it. PlannerService.improves (816) also puts goals first (end rank capped at each target) before completeness, so a complete follow-up can no longer drop a goal the installed plan reaches. Full rerun at 322f8b5: 698 tests, 0 failures, incl. CoreContractTest.goalsAreComparedInStrictPriorityOrderBeforeTheObjective; PlanRealPackTest.goalOrderDecidesWhoGetsMaxWhenTwoMustGoalsCompete, strictGoalPriorityKeepsTheFirstGoalInTheAuditCases, strictGoalPriorityOnRandomMidGameTriples; PlannerServiceFollowUpTest.improvesComparesGoalsInPriorityOrderThenMaxedLinksThenRanks; FinalIntegrationTest.aMissedGoalNamesOnlyTheGoalThePlannerKept.

items.requirement: Prefer less fragile routes and sensible resource buffers
items.evidence: The fee reserve is a kernel legality rule: feeAffordable (Kernel.java:566-570) pays a fee only with 2,500 left over unless waiting would miss the milestone (feeUrgent); unlockGroup and sideLegal use it (415, 438). optionalHold (462-474) makes paid training (activityLegal, 728) and dating-site notes (noteOpen, 355) leave pending fees (due within 14 days, affordable) plus the reserve, and the reserve on a fee day. Heuristics.feeNeeds adds the reserve to saving targets; Labels.FEE_NOTE states the rules in 需要注意. PlanValidator checks the cash buffer (394, 489) and the fee-day reserve (411-417). Robustness: FRAGILE_MAX_PENALTY, goalBuffer on by default (Profile.java:49), no Tartarus income assumed. Passing: SideStepTest.aFeeThatCanWaitKeepsTheReserve; PlanRealPackTest.devilChainOnTheRealPack and unlockFeeDaysKeepTheReserveOnTheRealPack (5 scenarios, no validator warnings); CoreContractTest.unlockFeesKeepAReserveOnTop, fragileMaxCountsOnlyOtherLinksMaxedOnTheirLastChance. Minor (noted by the auditor): a reserve breach is only a validator warning; the user's own cash buffer defaults to 0.

items.requirement: F11. Never claim a failed heuristic search proves infeasibility; distinguish unmet goals, insufficient rule coverage and search limits
items.evidence: Plan.followUp (Plan.java:32), followUpPending() and budgetNoteZh() (43-51) say 「稍后会自动再算一次」 only while budgetExhausted && !followUp; otherwise 「后半段是粗略安排；记下一个结果后会重新安排」, which is true (a record changes the revision and triggers a replan). PlannerService queues exactly one follow-up per revision key with twice the budget (needsFollowUpLocked 777-780, nextJob 880-897, runEnded 958-967); a result that is not better, or fails, is marked by followUpDoneLocked (788-802, 918-935), so a restart cannot re-promise. ui/InfoPages.budgetLine (90-95) reads plan.followUp directly. Unmet goals read as this plan's outcome (Labels.java:680-697, LinkStatus.shortfall); rule coverage is worded apart (story holds, lost rescue, tower nights); the search-limit note comes first. No 时间不够/不可能/来不及/排不开 in UI or engine literals. Passing: PlannerServiceFollowUpTest 7/7; ReauditWordingTest budget tests; FinalIntegrationTest.theFollowUpFlagDecidesTheBudgetLine; CoreContractTest budget and notes tests.
